name: musicorbit
description: Self-hosted, open-source music library, browser player, and acquisition hub.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @musicorbit/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @musicorbit/api" "npm run dev -w @musicorbit/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @musicorbit/shared && npm run dev -w @musicorbit/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @musicorbit/shared && npm run dev -w @musicorbit/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @musicorbit/shared && npm run build -w @musicorbit/api && npm run build -w @musicorbit/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @musicorbit/shared && npm run typecheck -w @musicorbit/api && npm run typecheck -w @musicorbit/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @musicorbit/shared && npm run test -w @musicorbit/api
